mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low rates reduce discount rates and increase liquidity for equity valuation.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 238.0 signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL remains above 238.0 for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.3%) and employment (PAYEMS < 138749) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the trigger condition, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102.0) signals supply-side economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 102.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 138000) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as robust employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In periods when PAYEMS > 138000, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 420000) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when RSAFS < 420000, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 420000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signals broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the trigger condition, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.0) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.2%) signals imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the trigger condition, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
